verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability for a banking platform with web banking, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an in-product AI assistant or task delegation. The llms.txt and markdown docs only serve documentation to external LLMs, and the approval flows and scheduled transfers are not AI delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
